# Fun Shapes: Ring
# Generated from JuliaBUGS.BUGSExamples.VOLUME_3.ring
using JuliaBUGS

model_def = JuliaBUGS.@bugs("""
model
{
   x ~ dunif(-1, 1)
   y ~ dunif(-1, 1)
   O1 <- 0
   O1 ~ dbern(constraint1)
   constraint1 <- step(x * x + y * y - 1)   
   O2 <- 1
   O2 ~ dbern(constraint2)
   constraint2 <- step( x * x + y * y - 0.25)
}
""", false)

build_model(data, inits = (;)) = JuliaBUGS.compile(model_def, data, inits)
